name: Restore Default Network Latency Profile
description: Restores default Windows network latency settings to improve connection stability and throughput for online gaming.

description_i18n.en: Restores default Windows network latency settings to improve connection stability and throughput for online gaming.
description_i18n.de: Stellt die Standard-Netzwerklatenz-Einstellungen von Windows wieder her, um Verbindungsstabilität und Durchsatz für Online-Gaming zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Restaure les paramètres de latence réseau par défaut de Windows pour améliorer la stabilité et le débit des connexions en ligne.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets NetworkThrottlingIndex to 10 and SystemResponsiveness to 20 in the Multimedia SystemProfile registry Removes TcpAckFrequency, TCPNoDelay, and TcpDelAckTicks from active physical network adapter interfaces
